title: Kinship Ventures 创始人对谈：从健康消费到多元配置
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Talk about the partnership of how you two came together to try to make this more of a repeatable pattern when it comes to investing in this space.
segments.zh: 谈谈你们的合作，你们如何走到一起，试图在这个领域的配置上形成更可复制的模式。

segments.en: Through the lens of wellness, I mean, you know, I started investing off of my own balance sheet and when I started Goop, essentially,
segments.zh: 从健康领域的视角，我最初是用自己的资金做配置，当我创办Goop时，

segments.en: that's how I started to see some deal flow. And I invested, I started investing in things that I liked and used and then areas that I was interested in or felt some kind of inkling
segments.zh: 就这样我开始看到一些项目流。我配置于自己喜欢和使用的东西，以及我感兴趣或隐约觉得市场会朝那个方向发展的领域。

segments.en: that the market was going to go that way. Mojo always says I helped create the tam of wellness.
segments.zh: Mojo总说是我帮助创造了健康领域的总体可寻址市场。

segments.en: Through. And I think to some degree that's accurate, I mean, 18 years ago when I started Goop, there wasn't, you know, wellness was such a nascent
segments.zh: 某种程度上这是准确的。18年前我创办Goop时，健康领域还非常初期，

segments.en: category and now it's become massive.
segments.zh: 如今它已变得非常庞大。

segments.en: So I think we, as founders, we've come together through that lens of instinct and our love of consumer
segments.zh: 所以我认为，作为创始人，我们通过那种直觉和对消费领域的热爱走到了一起，

segments.en: and our love of what's possible and that can be across any sector, whether it's in consumer, CPG or AI or anything.
segments.zh: 以及对可能性的热爱，这可以跨越任何行业，无论是消费、快消品还是人工智能等。

segments.en: Well, when we talk about that, Tam, and you certainly popularized it, I mean, I grew up in a very sort of a holistic household if you will and it was very niche back then.
segments.zh: 当我们谈论那个总体可寻址市场时，你确实让它流行起来。我成长在一个非常整体式的家庭，那时还非常小众。

segments.en: I mean, you know, you went to somebody's basement, you know, get your grains and whatever else you need it and now it's everywhere.
segments.zh: 你得去别人的地下室拿谷物之类的东西，现在它无处不在。
